<h1>批量漏洞挖掘思路</h1>
<h3><a id="x3NWo"></a>1、在线文库查询</h3>
<p><a id="ue3214a27"></a></p>
<p>使用在线漏洞文库收集nday或者1day的漏洞payload对网站进行漏洞挖掘。</p>
<p><a id="Gxwtx"></a></p>
<p>佩奇漏洞文库：<br>https://www.yuque.com/peiqiwiki/peiqi-poc-wiki<br>http://wiki.peiqi.tech/<br>白阁漏洞文库：<br>https://wiki.bylibrary.cn/%E6%BC%8F%E6%B4%9E%E5%BA%93/01-CMS%E6%BC%8F%E6%B4%9E/ActiveMQ/ActiveMQ%E4%BB%BB%E6%84%8F%E6%96%87%E4%BB%B6%E4%B8%8A%E4%BC%A0%E6%BC%8F%E6%B4%9E/<br>狼组安全团队公开知识库：<br>https://wiki.wgpsec.org/knowledge/<br>Morker文库：<br>https://wiki.96.mk/<br>风炫漏洞库：<br>https://evalshell.com/<br>exploit-db漏洞库：<br>https://www.exploit-db.com/</p>
<p><a id="EVfNF"></a></p>
<h3>2、使用语句定位到产品，然后看到这些资产，使用工具批量收集对应网站</h3>
<p><a id="ZSIHM"></a></p>
<p>fofax：https://github.com/xiecat/fofax </p>
<p><a id="u4ad561a8"></a></p>
<p>这里通过fofa_viewer进行资产获取，将我们刚刚在fofa搜索到的资产进行导出</p>
<p><a id="dFCnJ"></a></p>
<h3>3、批量探测网站存活状态</h3>
<p><a id="uUOb2"></a></p>
<p>httpx.exe -timeout 15 -l 上一步保存文件.txt -o result.txt -mc 200 </p>
<p><a id="uc94af103"></a></p>
<p>使用工具httpx对上面收集到的url做一个存活验证，首先筛选出存活的url来，然后再进行测试，不然会浪费我们很多时间，这里我们使用httpx把存活的url保存到文件中</p>
<p><a id="iwXzO"></a></p>
<h3>4、批量测试漏洞</h3>
<p><a id="u0f61f7cb"></a></p>
<p>根据泛微OA E-Cology BshServlet 远程代码执行漏洞漏洞命令执行的特征，我们简单写一个多线程检测脚本</p>
<p><a id="ipKqo"></a></p>
<p>from os import O_EXCL<br>import requests<br>import threading<br><br>def POC_1(target_url,ss):<br>vuln_url = target_url + r"/weaver/bsh.servlet.BshServlet"<br>headers = {<br>"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/87.0.4280.141 Safari/537.36",<br>"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded",<br>}<br>try:<br>response = requests.get(url=vuln_url, headers=headers, timeout=5,verify=False)<br>if response.status_code == 200 and "BeanShell Test" in response.text:<br>with open("存在漏洞的url.txt", 'a', encoding='UTF-8') as f:<br>print("\033[32m[o] 目标{}存在漏洞".format(target_url))<br>f.write(vuln_url + "\n")<br>else:<br>print("\033[31m[x] 目标不存在漏洞")<br>except Exception as e:<br>print("\033[31m[x] 请求失败", e)<br><br>with open("fanwei.txt","r",encoding='UTF-8')as f:<br>for i in f.readlines():<br>ss = i.replace('\n','')<br>ip = i.replace('\n','')<br>threading.Thread(target=POC_1,args=(ip,ss)).start()</p>
<p><a id="ud0f7ec12"></a></p>
<p>就可以通过脚本来实现检测这些存活的url是否有漏洞</p>
<p><a id="yLRcc"></a></p>
<h3>5、处理数据</h3>
<p><a id="u4b6aabb4"></a></p>
<p>漏洞url</p>
<p><a id="u5a1bde40"></a></p>
<p>-&gt;根据url（因为有些网站是ip站）反查域名</p>
<p><a id="u93c26237"></a></p>
<p>-&gt;根据域名反查域名权重</p>
<p><a id="u44f777ea"></a></p>
<p>-&gt;根据有权重的域名反查域名备案名称</p>
<p><a id="u2320078a"></a></p>
<p>-&gt;根据备案名称查询公司的基本信息，例如公司的所在地方和行业等等，</p>
<p><a id="u44e8443b"></a><a id="oxHGX"></a></p>
<h4>1、域名和权重和公司的批量检测</h4>
<p><a id="u91005177"></a></p>
<p>爱站：https://rank.aizhan.com/</p>
<p><a id="u68d440ff"></a></p>
<p>我们需要对上边收集过来的存在漏洞的url列表去做一个根据ip反查域名，然后域名反查权重</p>
<p><a id="Tt3kc"></a></p>
<p>#-- coding:UTF-8 --<br>import re, time<br>from urllib.parse import urlparse<br>import requests<br>from fake_useragent import UserAgent<br>from tqdm import tqdm<br>import os<br><br># 爱站<br>def aizhan_chaxun(ip, ua):<br>aizhan_headers = {<br>'Host': 'dns.aizhan.com',<br>'User-Agent': ua.random,<br>'Accept': 'text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/webp,*/*;q=0.8',<br>'Accept-Language': 'zh-CN,zh;q=0.8,zh-TW;q=0.7,zh-HK;q=0.5,en-US;q=0.3,en;q=0.2',<br>'Accept-Encoding': 'gzip, deflate, br',<br>'Referer': 'https://dns.aizhan.com/'}<br>aizhan_url = 'https://dns.aizhan.com/' + str(ip) + '/'<br>try:<br>aizhan_r = requests.get(url=aizhan_url, headers=aizhan_headers, timeout=2).text<br>aizhan_nums = re.findall(r'''&lt;span class="red"&gt;(.*?)&lt;/span&gt;''', aizhan_r)<br>if int(aizhan_nums[0]) &gt; 0:<br>aizhan_domains = re.findall(r'''rel="nofollow" target="_blank"&gt;(.*?)&lt;/a&gt;''', aizhan_r)<br>return aizhan_domains<br>except:<br>pass<br><br>def catch_result(i):<br>ua_header = UserAgent()<br>i = i.strip()<br>if "http://" not in i:<br>i="http://"+i<br>try:<br>ip = urlparse(i).netloc<br>aizhan_result = aizhan_chaxun(ip, ua_header)<br>time.sleep(1)<br>if (aizhan_result != None ):<br>with open("ip反查结果.txt", 'a') as f:<br>result = "[url]:" + i + " " + " [aizhan]:" + str(aizhan_result[0])<br>print(result)<br>f.write(result + "\n")<br>else:<br>with open("反查失败列表.txt", 'a') as f:<br>f.write(i + "\n")<br>except:<br>pass<br><br><br>if __name__ == '__main__':<br>url_list = open("待ip反查.txt", 'r').readlines()<br>url_len = len(open("待ip反查.txt", 'r').readlines())<br>#每次启动时清空两个txt文件<br>if os.path.exists("反查失败列表.txt"):<br>f = open("反查失败列表.txt", 'w')<br>f.truncate()<br>if os.path.exists("ip反查结果.txt"):<br>f = open("ip反查结果.txt", 'w')<br>f.truncate()<br>for i in tqdm(url_list):<br>catch_result(i)</p>
<p><a id="u7c1ed3e4"></a></p>
<p>将前边收集到存在漏洞的url存在一个叫ip反查.txt的文件里，然后运行脚本</p>
<p><a id="u71a26ef4"></a></p>
<p>拿到解析的域名后，继续对域名权重进行检测，继续采用爱站进行权重检测，批量检测权重脚本</p>
<p><a id="GyVrV"></a></p>
<p># -- coding:UTF-8 --<br>import requests <br>import re<br>import getopt<br>import sys<br>import threadpool<br>import urllib.parse<br>import urllib.request<br>import ssl<br>from urllib.error import HTTPError,URLError<br>import time<br>ssl._create_default_https_context = ssl._create_stdlib_context<br><br><br>headers={<br>'Host': 'baidurank.aizhan.com',<br>'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/80.0.3987.163 Safari/537.36',<br>'Sec-Fetch-Dest': 'document',<br>'Accept': 'text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/webp,image/apng,*/*;q=0.8,application/signed-exchange;v=b3;q=0.9',<br>'Cookie': ''<br>}<br><br><br>def google_simple(url, j):<br>google_pc = "https://pr.aizhan.com/{}/".format(url)<br>bz = 0<br>http_or_find = 0<br>try:<br>response = requests.get(google_pc, timeout=10).text<br>http_or_find = 1<br>result_pc = re.findall(re.compile(r'&lt;span&gt;谷歌PR：&lt;/span&gt;&lt;a&gt;(.*?)/&gt;&lt;/a&gt;'), response)[0]<br>result_num = result_pc.split('alt="')[1].split('"')[0].strip()<br>if int(result_num) &gt; 0:<br>bz = 1<br>result = '[+] 谷歌权重:' + result_num + ' ' + j<br>return result, bz<br>except:<br>if (http_or_find != 0):<br>result = "[!]格式错误:" + "j"<br>return result, bz<br>else:<br>time.sleep(3)<br>return google_simple(url, j)<br><br><br>def getPc(domain):<br>aizhan_pc = 'https://baidurank.aizhan.com/api/br?domain={}&amp;style=text'.format(domain)<br>try:<br><br>req = urllib.request.Request(aizhan_pc, headers=headers)<br>response = urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=10)<br>b = response.read()<br>a = b.decode("utf8")<br>result_pc = re.findall(re.compile(r'&gt;(.*?)&lt;/a&gt;'),a)<br>pc = result_pc[0]<br><br>except HTTPError as u:<br>time.sleep(3)<br>return getPc(domain)<br><br>return pc<br><br>def getMobile(domain):<br>aizhan_pc = 'https://baidurank.aizhan.com/api/mbr?domain={}&amp;style=text'.format(domain)<br>try:<br># b = requests.post(url=post_url,headers=headers, proxies=proxy, timeout = 7)<br># res = urllib.request.urlopen(aizhan_pc,timeout=10)<br># # res = opener.open(aizhan_pc,timeout=10)<br># a = res.read().decode('UTF-8')<br>req = urllib.request.Request(aizhan_pc, headers=headers)<br>response = urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=10)<br>b = response.read()<br>a = b.decode("utf8")<br>result_m = re.findall(re.compile(r'&gt;(.*?)&lt;/a&gt;'),a)<br>mobile = result_m[0]<br>except HTTPError as u:<br>time.sleep(3)<br>return getMobile(domain)<br><br><br>return mobile<br># 权重查询<br>def seo(name,url):<br><br>try:<br><br>result_pc = getPc(name)<br>result_mobile = getMobile(name)<br><br>except Exception as u:<br># print(u)<br>result_pc = '0'<br>result_mobile = '0'<br><br>print('[- 目标{}获取权重失败,自动设为0'.format(url))<br># print('运行正常')<br>print('[+ 百度权重:'+result_pc+' 移动权重:'+result_mobile+' Url:'+url)<br>with open('vul.txt','a',encoding='utf-8') as y:<br>y.write('[百度权重:'+result_pc+','+"移动权重:"+result_mobile+','+url+']'+'\n')<br><br>return True<br><br>def exp(name1):<br># opts, args = getopt.getopt(sys.argv[1:], '-u:-r:', ['url', 'read'])<br># print(name1)<br>try:<br>name = name1[name1.rfind('/'):].strip('/')<br># print(name)<br>rew = seo(name,name1)<br><br>except Exception as u:<br># except:<br>print(u)<br>print('[- 目标{}检测失败，已写入fail.txt等待重新检测'.format(name1))<br># file_fail.write(name1+'\n')<br>with open('fail.txt',mode='a',encoding='utf-8') as o:<br>o.write(name1+'\n')<br><br><br>def multithreading(funcname, params=[], filename="ip.txt", pools=15):<br>works = []<br>with open(filename, "r") as f:<br>for i in f:<br>func_params = [i.rstrip("\n")] + params<br>works.append((func_params, None))<br>pool = threadpool.ThreadPool(pools)<br>reqs = threadpool.makeRequests(funcname, works)<br><br>[pool.putRequest(req) for req in reqs]<br>pool.wait()<br><br>def main():<br>multithreading(exp, [], "存在漏洞的url.txt", 15) # 默认15线程<br>print("全部check完毕，请查看当前目录下的vul.txt")<br><br>if __name__ == "__main__":<br># st = False<br># main(st)<br>main()<br><br></p>
<p><a id="ucecaca68"></a></p>
<p>然后拿着有权重的站，批量根据域名反查备案名称， <strong>ip2domain </strong> ， 该工具可用于对跑到的ip批量查询域名及百度权重、备案信息，快速确定ip所属企业，方便提交漏洞。</p>
<p><a id="u5945c0a9"></a> 工具链接：https://github.com/Sma11New/ip2domain</p>
<p><a id="fxTZJ"></a></p>
<p>python ip2domain.py -f 存在漏洞的url.txt -t 10 --icp -o 根据域名反查厂商.txt </p>
<p><a id="uecfa8911"></a></p>
<p><a id="u039daa63"></a><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3723860/202601/3723860-20260111095025247-1683868848.png"></p>
<p><a id="u015870b4"></a></p>
<p>2、查找公司基本工商信息，例如说：注册公司的所在地区，所属行业等</p>
<p><a id="uc24c0e4c"></a></p>
<p>使用企查查或天眼查</p>
